description: Review and testimonial cards for dental offices.

entries.author: Sample entry
entries.text: I avoided dentists for years. They explained everything, numbed me properly, and the crown was done in one visit.

entries.author: Sample entry
entries.text: Front desk got me in the same day with a toothache. Fair price, no upsell, and the pain was gone by dinner.

entries.author: Sample entry
entries.text: My kids used to dread the dentist. Now they ask when they get to go back. That says everything.

entries.author: Sample entry
entries.text: Whitening results were better than promised and they checked on me the next day. Professional from start to finish.
